items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee narrates an anecdote about Gene Sedric and Willie the Lion ('Sedric came up... Willie the Lion was sitting there...'), but does not describe a personal interaction or relationship between himself and Willie the Lion.

ctx.x: Gene Sedric. Sedric came up and while he was sitting there playing he was -- Willie the Lion was sitting there, ding-da-dingle ling, dingle linga linga, playing, you know, and Sedric say he'd sit there a while, and he looks, listens (laughs) so he take his bag out from under his arm, and lay it down, and Willie the Lion -- look -- Willie the Lion looks at him sitting there. If you can't play that
thing, don't take it out. You know, and kept on --
